feedback.problem:
Given that $C$ and $D$ are finite, non-overlapping regions and that

$$
{∬}_{C}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A=\frac{1}{2},\,{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A=\frac{3}{2},
$$

find the value of 

$$
{∬}_{C\cup D}\frac{f(x,y)}{2}\text{ }\text{d}A.
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the linearity and additivity of double integrals, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{C\cup D}\frac{f(x,y)}{2}\text{ }\text{d}A & =\frac{1}{2}{∬}_{C\cup D}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{1}{2}({∬}_{C}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A+{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{3}{2}) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 2 \\  & =1\end{aligned}
$$
